bibl.title: Egypt and Eastern Commerce during the Second Century AD and Later, Money and Flows of Coinage in the Red Sea Trade.
bibl.seg: Dario Nappo, Egypt and Eastern Commerce during the Second Century AD and Later, Money and Flows of Coinage in the Red Sea Trade.
Andrew Wilson & Alan Bowman (edd.), Trade, Commerce, and the State in the Roman World (Oxford, 2018) pp. 557-578, figg.
bibl.note: The export of coins kept going well into the second century AD, contrary to any idea of decline of such commerce after Nero, based on the numismatic evidence. The second century AD itself is a period for which we have significant literary, archaeological, and documentary evidence that the trade between Rome and India was just not continuing, but probably entering into a phase of expansion.
